# Plugin API Reference

Everything RPG Reactor offers a plugin, written from the engine's own code: the functions meant for game plugins, RPG Reactor's plugin commands, and the editor plugin interface. [Writing Plugins](PLUGIN-DEVELOPMENT.md) shows how to use them; the [Engine API Reference](https://rpgreactor.org/docs/api) lists every function in the runtime.

<!-- Generated by editor/build-scripts/plugin-api-reference.cjs from runtime/, src/EditorPlugins.js and build-scripts/plugin-api-commands.json. Do not edit: change those and run it again. -->

## What a plugin is written for

A plugin's `@target` line, which the Plugin Manager shows beside its author:

| `@target` | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Reactor` | A game plugin written for RPG Reactor (`RPGReactor` is the same) |
| `MZ Reactor` | A game plugin written for both RPG Maker MZ and RPG Reactor |
| `MZ` | An RPG Maker MZ plugin |
| `MV` | An RPG Maker MV plugin |
| `ReactorEditor` | An editor plugin |

## Functions for game plugins

### Lighting on a 3D map

- `Reactor3D.setMapAmbient(values, duration)`: Ease the map's ambient light to a new level and colour; `values === null` restores the authored ambient. *(runtime/reactor_3d_lighting.js)*

- `Reactor3D.switchLight(target, state)`: Turn a light, or every light of a tag, on, off or over. *(runtime/reactor_3d_lighting.js)*

- `Reactor3D.transformLight(target, values, duration)`: Ease a light, or every light of a tag, to new values over `duration` frames. `values` holds any of LIGHT_OVERRIDE_FIELDS; a field left out is left alone. Colour may be "#rrggbb" or a number. `values === null` clears the target's overrides. *(runtime/reactor_3d_lighting.js)*

### 3D models

- `Reactor3D.transformModel(character, target, duration)`: Give a character's model a transform to ease to over `duration` frames (0: at once). *(runtime/reactor_3d_models.js)*

- `Reactor3D.playModelAnimation(character, name, options)`: Queue a named action animation on a character's model. *(runtime/reactor_3d_models.js)*

### Ground

- `Reactor3D.deriveElevation(mapData, flags, options)`: A starting elevation derived from the map's own passability. An existing 2D map carries no height data, and asking an author to paint a whole city by hand before seeing anything in 3D is a poor first experience. Impassable cells are overwhelmingly walls, buildings and cliffs, so raising them recovers a recognisable massing from a map that was never authored for 3D — the starting point an author then edits, not a final answer. Passability is read the way `Game_Map.checkPassage` reads it: the planes are walked top-down and the first tile with a decisive flag wins, with [*] tiles skipped because they say nothing about passage. *(runtime/reactor_3d.js)*

- `Reactor3D.stairAt(mapData, x, y)`: Whether a stair piece stands on the cell x, y of a map. *(runtime/reactor_3d_world.js)*

### Characters

- `character.reactorIsWalking()`: Whether a walk to a tile is under way. *(runtime/reactor_objects_map.js)*

### Vehicles

- `ReactorVehicles.Drive.state()`: `$gamePlayer._rrDrive` while driving, every field a number; else null. *(runtime/reactor_vehicles_drive.js)*

### Battles on the map

- `$gameFight.commandVehicleAttack()`: The vehicle's own attack, aimed at once (a HUD with its own lists; a script). *(runtime/reactor_vehicles_mount.js)*

### Steam

For a game on Steam (Database › System 2 › Steam); every call does nothing without Steam. See [Steam for games](STEAM-FOR-GAMES.md).

- `ReactorSteam.available()`: Steam is running for this game
- `ReactorSteam.unlock(apiName)`: unlock an achievement
- `ReactorSteam.clear(apiName)`: lock it again (for testing)
- `ReactorSteam.isUnlocked(apiName)`: whether an achievement is unlocked
- `ReactorSteam.stat(name)`: an integer stat's value
- `ReactorSteam.setStat(name, value)`: set an integer stat

### Runtime events

`ReactorEvents.on(name, handler)` hears what happens in battles, on doors and in vehicles, without replacing a method. [Runtime Events](RUNTIME-EVENTS.md) lists every event and what it carries.

## RPG Reactor's plugin commands

RPG Reactor's own event commands are plugin commands of the plugin `RPGReactor`. Every argument arrives as text, as any plugin command's does. A plugin runs one as an event would:

```js
PluginManager.callCommand(interpreter, "RPGReactor", "LightSwitch", { target: "#village", state: "on" });
```

### Battle

#### Change Enemy Equipment (`ChangeEnemyEquipment`)

Puts a weapon or armor into one equipment slot of one enemy in the current troop, or empties the slot.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enemyIndex` | number | Which troop member, counted from 0. |
| `slotIndex` | number | Which equipment slot, counted from 0. |
| `kind` | number | 2 for a weapon, 3 for an armor. |
| `itemId` | number | The weapon or armor's database number; 0 empties the slot. |

### Vehicles

#### Get On Reactor Vehicle (`GetOnVehicle`)

Puts the party on a vehicle, walking aboard or at once.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string | Which vehicle: left out or "this" is the event running the command; also "nearest", "ridden", "boat", "ship" or "airship" (the stock ones), an event number on this map, or a vehicle's identity such as "0:3". |
| `instant` | boolean | Boards at once with no walk; false when left out. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until boarding is done; true when left out. |

#### Get Off Reactor Vehicle (`GetOffVehicle`)

Takes the party off the vehicle it is riding.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `instant` | boolean | Gets off at once with no walk; false when left out. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until the party is off; true when left out. |

### 3D

#### Play Model Animation (`PlayModelAnimation`)

Plays a named animation on a character's 3D model; several in a row queue up and play one after another.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | number | Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number (a placed prop is 10000 + its prop number). |
| `animation` | string | The animation's name from the model; empty stops the animation and clears the queue. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until that animation has played once through (at most 1800 frames); the player can still walk meanwhile. |

#### Set Model Animation Speed (`SetModelAnimationSpeed`)

Changes how fast a character's 3D model animates.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | number | Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number. |
| `speed` | number | Speed in percent, 1 to 1000; 100 when left out or not a number. |

#### Play 3D Effect (`PlayModelEffect`)

Plays one of a 3D model's own effects at the spot it was placed on the model.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | number | Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number. |
| `effect` | string | The effect's name from the model's effects list; empty does nothing. |

#### Speak 3D Dialogue (`SpeakModel3D`)

Plays a voice clip from a 3D character and moves its mouth with the sound, or stops that voice.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `operation` | speak \| stop | "stop" stops the character's voice; anything else speaks. |
| `target` | number | Who speaks: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number. |
| `audio` | string | The sound file in audio/se, without its extension. |
| `volume` | number | Volume, 90 when left out. |
| `pitch` | number | Pitch, 100 when left out. |
| `pan` | number | Left-right pan, 0 when left out. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until the voice finishes; true unless "false". |

#### Change 3D Camera (`ChangeCamera3D`)

Moves the 3D map camera to another view, eased over a number of frames.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | fixed \| topDown \| isometric \| thirdPerson \| firstPerson | The camera mode; some other spellings are accepted, and an unknown one is fixed. |
| `pitch` | number | Tilt in degrees, -89 to 89; blank uses the mode's own. |
| `yaw` | number | Turn in degrees, -360 to 360; blank uses the mode's own. |
| `distance` | number | Distance from what it looks at, in tiles, 0.5 to 1024; blank uses the mode's own. |
| `fov` | number | Field of view in degrees, 5 to 150; blank uses the mode's own. |
| `focus` | auto \| display \| player \| event | What the camera centres on; anything else is auto (the mode's own choice). |
| `eventId` | number | For focus event: the event to follow; 0 is this event. |
| `duration` | number | Frames to ease over, 0 to 6000; 0 is at once. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until the camera has arrived (only when duration is above 0). |
| `keep` | boolean | Keeps this camera on later maps instead of each map's own. |

#### Transform 3D Model (`TransformModel3D`)

Moves, turns and scales a character's 3D model from its placed pose, eased over a number of frames.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | number | Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number (a placed prop is 10000 + its prop number). |
| `offsetX` | number | Shift left-right in tiles; 0 when left out. |
| `offsetY` | number | Shift along the map's depth (toward or away from the bottom of the map) in tiles; 0 when left out. |
| `offsetZ` | number | Shift up or down in tiles; 0 when left out. |
| `yaw` | number | Turn in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `pitch` | number | Tilt forward or back in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `roll` | number | Roll sideways in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `scaleX` | number | Width scale; 1 when left out or not above 0. |
| `scaleY` | number | Height scale; 1 when left out or not above 0. |
| `scaleZ` | number | Depth scale; 1 when left out or not above 0. |
| `duration` | number | Frames to ease over; 0 is at once. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event for the duration. |

### Lighting

#### Switch Light (`LightSwitch`)

Turns a map light, or every light with a tag, on, off, or the other way.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | A light's id, or "#tag" for every light with that tag. |
| `state` | on \| off \| toggle | "off" turns it off, "toggle" flips it, anything else turns it on. |

#### Transform Light (`TransformLight`)

Eases a map light, or every light with a tag, to new position, direction, size, brightness or color.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | A light's id, or "#tag" for every light with that tag. |
| `x` | number | Position across in tiles (an offset when the light rides a character); blank leaves it as placed. |
| `y` | number | Position down the map in tiles (an offset when the light rides a character); blank leaves it as placed. |
| `height` | number | Height in tiles; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `yaw` | number | Direction it points, in degrees; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `pitch` | number | Tilt in degrees; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `radius` | number | Reach in tiles; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `angle` | number | Cone angle in degrees, for a spotlight; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `width` | number | Beam width in tiles; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `intensity` | number | Brightness; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `color` | string | Color as "#rrggbb"; blank leaves it as placed. |
| `duration` | number | Frames to ease over; 0 is at once. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event for the duration. |
| `reset` | boolean | Drops what earlier commands set on this target, back to the light as placed; the other fields are then ignored. |

#### Change Ambient Light (`AmbientLight`)

Eases the map's overall ambient light to a new brightness and color.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number | Brightness from 0 to 1; blank leaves it as it is. |
| `color` | string | Color as "#rrggbb"; blank leaves it as it is. |
| `duration` | number | Frames to ease over; 0 is at once. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event for the duration. |
| `reset` | boolean | Goes back to the map's own ambient light at once; the other fields are then ignored. |

### Game Flow

#### Scoped Wait (`ScopedWait`)

Holds the event until something happens while the player keeps moving: a character's actions finish, time passes, a switch flips or a variable reaches a value.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | Whose actions to wait on: "all" (the default when left out), 0 this event, -1 the player, or an event number; only used by the actions mode. |
| `mode` | actions \| duration \| switch \| variable | What ends the wait; anything else is actions (model animations and, for one character, a forced move route; at most 3600 frames). |
| `duration` | number | For duration: frames to wait; 0 when left out. |
| `switchId` | number | For switch: the switch to watch; 1 when left out. |
| `switchValue` | boolean | For switch: "false" waits for OFF, anything else for ON. |
| `variableId` | number | For variable: the variable to watch; 1 when left out. |
| `op` | >= \| > \| = \| < \| <= \| != | For variable: how it is compared with value; anything else is >=. |
| `value` | number | For variable: the number compared against; 0 when left out. |
| `resume` | boolean | Lets the waiting event carry on with its own movement while it waits; true unless "false". |

#### Quest (`QuestSet`)

Discovers, completes, fails, resets, tracks or stops tracking a quest.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `questId` | string | The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too). |
| `action` | discover \| complete \| fail \| reset \| track \| untrack | What to do; discover when left out. track also discovers it; untrack only stops tracking if it is the tracked quest. |

#### Quest Objective (`QuestObjective`)

Shows, hides, completes, fails or reopens one objective of a quest, or all of them.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `questId` | string | The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too). |
| `objective` | string | The objective's number counted from 1, or "all" (also when left out). |
| `state` | complete \| show \| hide \| fail \| reset | What to set it to; complete when left out. reset opens it again. |

#### Quest Reward (`QuestReward`)

Shows or hides a quest's reward in the log, or gives it to the party.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `questId` | string | The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too). |
| `reward` | string | The reward's number counted from 1, or "all" (also when left out). |
| `state` | show \| hide \| give | "give" hands it over once, "hide" hides it, anything else shows it; show when left out. |

#### Open Quest Log (`OpenQuestLog`)

Opens the quest log screen.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `questId` | string | A quest's number or key to open the log on; left out, the log opens as usual. Not used when the log is VisuStella's. |

#### Steam Achievement (`SteamAchievement`)

Unlocks a Steam achievement, or locks it again for testing.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `api` | string | The achievement's API name from Steamworks (letters, digits, _ . -). |
| `action` | unlock \| clear | "clear" locks it again; anything else unlocks; unlock when left out. |

#### Character Creation (`CharacterCreation`)

Opens the character creation screen, or the character choice screen, as the game is set up.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `once` | boolean | Skips the screen when the player already has a character; any value given counts as on, so leave it out for off. |
| `required` | boolean | The player must finish, with no way back; any value given counts as on, so leave it out for off. |
| `switchId` | number | A switch turned ON when the player has their character and OFF when they backed out; 0 for none. |

### User Interfaces

#### Call User Interface (`CallUserInterface`)

Opens one of the game's custom user interface screens; does nothing in battle.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `interfaceId` | number | The interface's number from the User Interface editor; 0 does nothing. |

### Party Followers

#### Change Follower Formation (`ChangeFollowerFormation`)

Changes how the followers walk behind the leader, kept with the save.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `formation` | file \| loose \| rank \| wedge \| column \| scattered | The shape; any other value goes back to the game's own formation. |
| `spacing` | number | Tiles between members, 1 to 4. |
| `straggle` | number | How late and unevenly they follow, 0 to 100. |

#### Follower Orders (`FollowerOrders`)

Tells followers to follow, stay, walk to a tile, come back to the leader, hide or show.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `who` | all \| follower \| actor | "follower" is one place in the line, "actor" the follower who is that actor, anything else every follower. |
| `index` | number | For follower: the place in the line, counted from 1. |
| `actorId` | number | For actor: the actor's database number. |
| `order` | follow \| stay \| goto \| come \| hide \| show | The order; follow when left out. |
| `x` | number | For goto: the tile's x. |
| `y` | number | For goto: the tile's y. |
| `direction` | number | For goto: the way to face on arrival (2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up); anything else keeps its facing. |
| `wait` | boolean | For goto and come: holds the event until they arrive. |

### Battles on the Map

#### Start Battle on Map (`StartMapBattle`)

Starts a battle right on the map with the units there, or the ordinary battle screen when the mode in force is Classic.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | classic \| tactical \| action \| firstPerson | The battle mode; any other value (or none) uses the mode in force: the next-battle setting, the troop's, this map's, then the game's. |
| `who` | near \| map | "near" takes the units near the party that the start rule takes; anything else takes every unit on the map. |
| `troopId` | number | A troop whose members join the battle, placed round the party; 0 for none. Classic mode fights this troop on the battle screen. |
| `turns` | team \| initiative | How turns go; any other value uses the game's setting. |
| `objective` | defeatAll \| survive \| defeatUnit \| switch \| variable | What wins the battle; anything else is defeatAll. |
| `turnsToSurvive` | number | For survive: the turns to last (at least 1). |
| `unitEventId` | number | For defeatUnit: the event number of the unit to beat. |
| `goalSwitchId` | number | For switch: the battle is won when this switch is ON. |
| `goalVariableId` | number | For variable: the variable that is checked. |
| `goalValue` | number | For variable: the battle is won when the variable is at least this value. |
| `onTransfer` | keep \| escape | What happens if the party leaves the map mid-battle: "keep" keeps the battle, anything else counts as an escape. |
| `view` | string | "map" keeps the map's own camera on a 3D map; any other value uses the battle's own view; left out, the game's setting decides. |
| `canEscape` | boolean | Whether the party may run away. |
| `canLose` | boolean | Whether the game goes on after a loss instead of ending. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until the battle ends, then takes the If Win / If Escape / If Lose branch. |
| `resultVariable` | number | A variable that gets the result (0 win, 1 escape, 2 lose); 0 for none. |

#### Spawn Unit (`SpawnUnit`)

Puts a new actor or enemy unit on the map, which joins a battle that is running.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `record` | actor \| enemy | The kind of database record; anything else is enemy. |
| `id` | number | The actor's or enemy's database number. |
| `team` | ally \| enemy \| neutral | Its side; left out, ally for an actor and enemy for an enemy. Any other value spawns nothing. |
| `at` | cell \| event \| variables | "event" places it on a free spot next to a character, "variables" reads the tile from two variables, anything else uses x and y as the tile. |
| `x` | number | The tile's x, or with at = variables the variable holding it. |
| `y` | number | The tile's y, or with at = variables the variable holding it. |
| `eventId` | number | For at = event: the character to stand next to (0 this event, -1 the player, or an event number). |
| `height` | number | On a tile with several floors, which floor (a height); left out, the ground. |
| `direction` | number | The way it faces: 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up; 0 or left out keeps the default. |
| `template` | number | An event on this map whose pages the unit copies; 0 for none. |

#### Change Unit Side (`ChangeUnitSide`)

Moves a unit to another side, in a battle running now and in later battles on this map.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | number | The unit's event number; 0 is this event. |
| `team` | ally \| enemy \| neutral | The new side; any other value (or none) gives the unit back its own side from its event. |

#### Remove Unit (`RemoveUnit`)

Takes a unit out of the battle on the map.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | number | The unit's event number; 0 is this event. |
| `keep` | boolean | Leaves the event standing on the map instead of erasing it. |

#### End Battle on Map (`EndMapBattle`)

Ends the battle on the map with the result given.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `result` | win \| lose \| escape | How it ends; anything else is win. |

#### Change Battle Goal (`ChangeBattleGoal`)

Changes what wins the battle that is running on the map, checked at once.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `objective` | defeatAll \| survive \| defeatUnit \| switch \| variable | What wins the battle; anything else is defeatAll. |
| `turnsToSurvive` | number | For survive: the turns to last (at least 1). |
| `unitEventId` | number | For defeatUnit: the event number of the unit to beat; it joins the battle if it is not in it. |
| `goalSwitchId` | number | For switch: the battle is won when this switch is ON. |
| `goalVariableId` | number | For variable: the variable that is checked. |
| `goalValue` | number | For variable: the battle is won when the variable is at least this value. |

#### Change Battle Mode (`ChangeBattleMode`)

Sets which kind of battle the game, this map, or only the next battle uses.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | classic \| tactical \| action \| firstPerson \| default | The battle mode; "default" or any other value clears the setting for that scope. |
| `scope` | game \| map \| next | Where it applies: "map" this map, "next" the next battle only, anything else the whole game. |

#### Set Terrain Cost (`SetTerrainCost`)

Sets how many steps it costs to move onto a region or terrain tag in tactical battles from now on.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | region \| terrain | "terrain" means a terrain tag; anything else a region. |
| `id` | number | The region (1 and up) or terrain tag (0 and up). |
| `cost` | number | Steps it costs, up to 20; 0 blocks it, 1 or a non-number is the ordinary step. |

### Media Surfaces

#### Show Media Surface (`ShowVideoSurface`)

Shows a video or picture as a flat surface on the map, on a character, or on the screen; a new surface with the same number replaces the old one.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | number | The surface's number, 1 to 999999 (also read as surfaceId or videoId); required. |
| `movie` | string | The file (also read as file or filename): a .webm or .mp4 in movies/, or a .png, .jpg, .webp or .jxl in img/pictures/; required. |
| `target` | map \| event \| this-event \| player \| screen | What it is placed on (also read as bindTo); map when left out. |
| `eventId` | number | For target event: the event's number. |
| `x` | number | On the map the tile x; on a character an offset in pixels; on the screen the pixel x of its centre. 0 when left out. |
| `y` | number | On the map the tile y; on a character an offset in pixels; on the screen the pixel y of its centre. 0 when left out. |
| `z` | number | Height above the ground in tiles, on 3D maps only; 0 when left out. |
| `width` | number | Width in pixels, 1 to 8192; 320 when left out. |
| `height` | number | Height in pixels, 1 to 8192; 180 when left out. |
| `rotationX` | number | Turn about the x axis in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `rotationY` | number | Turn about the y axis in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `rotationZ` | number | Turn about the z axis in degrees (also read as rotation); 0 when left out. |
| `scaleX` | number | Horizontal scale; 1 when left out. |
| `scaleY` | number | Vertical scale; 1 when left out. |
| `opacity` | number | Opacity 0 to 255 (or alpha, 0 to 1); fully opaque when left out. |
| `loop` | boolean | Plays the video over and over; true when left out, and turned off when wait is on. |
| `muted` | boolean | Plays without sound; true when left out unless audio is given. |
| `audio` | boolean | The opposite of muted, read when muted is left out. |
| `volume` | number | Volume 0 to 100; 100 when left out. |
| `playbackRate` | number | Playback speed, 0.05 to 16; 1 when left out. |
| `layer` | number | Drawing layer, a number or below (0), ground (1), characters (3), above (5), screen (10); 3 when left out. |
| `depth` | number | On a 3D map, moves it toward the camera in tiles; in 2D it orders surfaces within a layer. 0 when left out. |
| `cullingDistance` | number | Hides it when it is this far outside the screen (2D, pixels) or from the camera (3D); 0 never hides it. |
| `scanlines` | number | Draws TV scanlines over it: true/false, or a strength from 0 to 1; 0 when left out. |
| `corners` | json | Four {x, y} points for a bent shape instead of the width × height rectangle (also x0..y3 one by one); left out, the rectangle. |
| `worldCorners` | json | Four {x, y} points the surface is stretched to in the world; left out, not used. |
| `wait` | boolean | Holds the event until the video ends; ignored for a picture. |

#### Transform Media Surface (`TransformVideoSurface`)

Changes a media surface that is showing: only the fields given change, at once.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | number | The number of a surface that is showing; required. |
| `target` | map \| event \| this-event \| player \| screen | What it is placed on. |
| `eventId` | number | For target event: the event's number. |
| `x` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `y` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `z` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `width` | number | Width in pixels; also resizes its shape unless it has corners set by hand. |
| `height` | number | Height in pixels; also resizes its shape unless it has corners set by hand. |
| `rotationX` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `rotationY` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `rotationZ` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `scaleX` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `scaleY` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `opacity` | number | Opacity 0 to 255 (or alpha, 0 to 1). |
| `loop` | boolean | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `muted` | boolean | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `audio` | boolean | The opposite of muted, read when muted is left out. |
| `volume` | number | Volume 0 to 100. |
| `playbackRate` | number | Playback speed, 0.05 to 16. |
| `layer` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `depth` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `cullingDistance` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `scanlines` | number | As in Show Media Surface. |
| `corners` | json | Four {x, y} points (also x0..y3 one by one); setting them marks the corners as set by hand. |
| `worldCorners` | json | As in Show Media Surface. |

#### Stop Media Surface (`StopVideoSurface`)

Removes a media surface and releases any event waiting on it.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | number | The surface's number (also read as surfaceId or videoId). |

### Not in the event command list

#### Scoped Wait (old name) (`WaitForModelAnimation`)

The first name of Scoped Wait, kept so events saved with it still work; it does exactly what Scoped Wait does.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `mode` | actions \| duration \| switch \| variable | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `duration` | number | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `switchId` | number | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `switchValue` | boolean | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `variableId` | number | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `op` | >= \| > \| = \| < \| <= \| != | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `value` | number | As in Scoped Wait. |
| `resume` | boolean | As in Scoped Wait. |

#### Call Battle Room Event (`BattleRoomEvent`)

In a battle fought in a Battle Room, runs the current page of one of that room's events (the Battle Presentation editor adds it to a troop page).

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | number | The event's number on the Battle Room's map. |

#### Skip Battle Sequence (`BattleSequenceSkip`)

Skips the battle action sequence that is playing, landing all its hits at once.

No arguments.

#### Battle Room Camera (`BattleRoomCamera`)

In a battle fought in a Battle Room, moves the room's camera to a set place and angle.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | Where it looks, across the room in tiles; left out keeps the current value. |
| `y` | number | Where it looks, down the room in tiles; left out keeps the current value. |
| `z` | number | Height of the point it looks at, in tiles; left out keeps the current value. |
| `yaw` | number | Turn in degrees; left out keeps the current value. |
| `pitch` | number | Tilt in degrees; left out keeps the current value. |
| `distance` | number | Distance from the point it looks at, in tiles; left out keeps the current value. |

#### Set Reactor Vehicle Location (`SetVehicleLocation`)

Moves a parked Reactor vehicle to a tile on this map, or takes it out of the world.

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `vehicle` | string | Which vehicle: left out or "this" is the event running the command; also an event number on this map, a vehicle's identity such as "0:3", "nearest" or "ridden". |
| `remove` | boolean | Takes the vehicle out of the world instead of moving it; false when left out. |
| `x` | number | The tile's x; required to move it. |
| `y` | number | The tile's y; required to move it. |
| `yaw` | number | The way it faces, in degrees; 0 when left out. |
| `z` | number | On a tile with several floors, the height to stand on; left out, the ground. |

## Editor plugins: `ReactorEditor`

An editor plugin (`@target ReactorEditor`, in a project's `js/editor-plugins/`) asks for its context once: `const plugin = ReactorEditor.plugin('MyPlugin');`. What it adds through the context goes when the project closes. [Writing Plugins](PLUGIN-DEVELOPMENT.md#editor-plugins) has an example.

### `ReactorEditor`

- `ReactorEditor.plugin(name)`: A plugin's context: made the first time it is asked for, while the plugin's script runs.
- `ReactorEditor.version`: The interface's version: 1. A later one keeps what this one has.
- `ReactorEditor.events`: The editor's moments a plugin can hear with plugin.on(event, handler).
- `ReactorEditor.project`: The open project: { path, name }, or null.
- `ReactorEditor.database`: The project's Database as the editor holds it: read it; change it through the Database.
- `ReactorEditor.currentMap()`: The map open in the editor, or null.

### A plugin's context

- `plugin.name`: The plugin's name: its file's, without .js.
- `plugin.parameters`: Its settings as the Plugin Manager saved them (each a string, as a game plugin's are).
- `plugin.addMenuItem({ label, action } = {})`: An entry under the editor's Plugins menu: its label, what choosing it does. Answers the menu entry.
- `plugin.addToolbarButton({ title, icon, action } = {})`: A button on the main toolbar, in a group of the plugins' own before the Forge's: its icon (a file of the plugin's own folder, a URL or SVG markup), its tooltip, what a click does. Answers the button; button.setActive(on) lights it as the toolbar's own buttons are lit.
- `plugin.addPanel({ id, title, icon, render, onToggle } = {})`: A panel over the map's corner with the editor's panel header (its icon, title, close button): render(body, panel) fills it each time it opens or is refreshed; onToggle(open) hears it open and close. Answers the panel: panel.open(), close(), toggle(), refresh().
- `plugin.file(relative)`: A file of the plugin's own folder, js/editor-plugins/<its name>/ (its icon, a picture), as a URL the editor can load.
- `plugin.on(event, handler)`: Hear one of the editor's moments (ReactorEditor.events): handler(detail). Answers a function that stops listening.
- `plugin.onDispose(fn)`: Run fn when the plugin is unloaded (the project closes, or the list is saved again): undo what it changed itself.
- `plugin.notify(text)`: A short message in the editor's own dialog, titled with the plugin's name.

### The editor's moments

`plugin.on(event, handler)` hears: `projectOpened`, `mapLoaded`, `beforeSave`, `saved`, `playtest`, `projectClosing`.
